reason: Canonical cursor parcel_77269 / HMLR INSPIRE 36834181 remains ineligible for Height Difference because BUILDING_PRESENT is still unproven. A materially different official London Borough of Islington Locally Listed Buildings register window was used. The April 2010 public register provides real building addresses, building counts, designation dates/grades and council reference numbers; 26 source records were processed. However the register contains no INSPIRE ID, UPRN, or Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, and the council page explicitly states that this register does not include additions after 2010. Therefore none of these address/reference records can be attributed exactly to parcel_77269 / INSPIRE 36834181 without an external spatial/address join, so no BUILDING_PRESENT state and no DEM/LIDAR parcel evidence are accepted.
